questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Smukke naturoplevelser tæt på og et sted, der ikke lå alt for langt fra Danmark.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Jeg var heldig, at være i kontakt med en fra mit studie årgangen over, der havde været afsted til Bergen og var god til at give info videre.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg boede sammen med norske roomies, så de hjalp mig en del med generelle ting i Bergen, men fik også en masse hjælp fra infocenteret på mit fakultet

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Det var ret let i Bergen - jeg fandt min lejlighed gennem hjemmesiden
Hybel.no

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det giver god mulighed for at bo sammen med nogle nordmænd, så du kommer rigtig godt ind i kuluren hurtigt.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Selve UIB's hjemmeside var meget intuitiv, og det var især nemt at finde de engelske kurser, der var mulighed for at tage. Til gengæld lidt sværere med de norske kurser.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: De var hurtige til at svare på mail og opkald, når jeg havde brug for hjælp fra mit fakultet

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik begge de hold, jeg havde registreret for i første omgang

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I første omgang var der ikke plads på det ene hold, jeg ønskede, fordi det egentlig kun var tiltænkt norske studerende, men ved at skrive til underviseren, fik jeg plads - de er meget søde til at undersøge mulighederne for dette.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg synes, at niveauet var en smule lavere end det danske niveau, jeg kender fra retorikbachelor-kurserne.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes, at underviserne var engagerede, men det var meget oplæsning fra powerpoint på det ene kursus jeg var (MEVI104), som jeg ikke er så vant til hjemme fra DK.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: LING123 (Språk og computere) og MEVI104 (Retorikk og strategisk kommunikation)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville især anbefale LING123, hvis man godt kan lide at arbejde med kodning af sprog - det var meget sjovt og læreligt.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte flere penge på ture væk fra Bergen, end jeg havde tænkt i første omgang

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Både transport og fitnesscenter havde rigtig gode studenterpriser i Bergen, og var en del billigere end jeg havde tænkt

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der var virkelig mange muligheder - organisationen "Sammen" havde virkelig mange tilbud og var virkelig let at tage del i.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville i hvert fald anbefale at få et abonnement til Trene Sammen i starter af semestret, der kan man betale for et enkelt semester til en virkelig lav pris, og har adgang til virkelig mange forskellige centre i byen og svømmehal.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville anbefale at tage ud og vandre på de mage fine fjelde omrking Bergen + gøre brug af DNT-hytterne

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes, at det som dansker var let at tappe ind i den norkse kultur - måske især fordi man bare kunne begå sig på sit eget sprog.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Hvis man vælger hold med lokale studernede, forestiller jeg mig, det er en del nemmere. Eller bo sammen med dem i kollektiver.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Jeg stødte ikke på noget, som jeg tænkte over, var meget udfordrende

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: at opleve deres kultur for at tage ud i det fri og vandre en masse

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
1. At bo sammen med lokale nordmænd, hvis muligt,
2. At huske at spørge om hjælp, så snart man bliver i tvivl om noget (både ift. erasmus og til uni)
3. At huske at tjekke op på om kurserne overlapper og eksamensformerne.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er virkelig mange gode kurser, der undervises på norsk, som der ikke er så mange, der får kigget på.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Jeg elskede at prøve at have undervisning på norsk, og hurtigt se, at jeg blev bedre til at forstå.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes, det var lidt ufordrende at finde hoved og hale i, hvordan Proof of Attendance skulle udfyldes - det virkede som om, der ikke var så god koordinering mellem KU og UIB - i hvert fald, var de på UIB meget usikre på, hvordan de måtte udfylde det.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
